== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A gatekey is a highly valuable and sophisticated artifact used to manipulate space. These devices can be utilized to create portals that transport users to specific locations, often targeting a [[scripted stone]] anchor. While they are difficult and time-consuming to manufacture, the cost of operating them is relatively low compared to their initial creation. Some gatekeys are designed for one-way travel, and certain versions can be used to access a private, internal space. A specific variation known as a [[void key]] contains such a private area and is quite rare, even among powerful individuals. Unlike [[gatestones]], which must be destroyed to function, a gatekey can be used repeatedly without being broken. Gatekeys are also used as security measures; some are custom-made for specific jailers and will shatter if they detect the wrong type of power, while others serve as keys to unlock complex doors and facilities.}}
